title: Alphabet Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Alphabet Inc. filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026 disclosing equity compensation awards (PSUs and GSUs) for four executive officers totaling approximately $150M in target grant value. The filing is Item 5.02 disclosure regarding compensatory arrangements for senior executives including CFO Anat Ashkenazi, President/CIO Ruth Porat, SVP Philipp Schindler, and Chief Legal Officer Kent Walker. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Alphabet's LDICC approved equity awards for four executives on April 7, 2026, with grants effective April 8, 2026
Total executive equity compensation includes PSUs with target value of $44M and GSUs with value of $86M, plus $21.67M transitional awards
PSUs vest based on Alphabet's relative TSR performance versus S&P 100 companies over 2026-2028 performance period, with 0%-200% multiplier
GSUs vest monthly over three years (2026-2028) and include supplemental transitional amounts related to SVP Bonus program discontinuation
Filing also lists 16 series of Alphabet senior notes (2.375% 2028 through 6.125% 2126) registered with Nasdaq
Alphabet is not an emerging growth company as defined by SEC rules
